title: Drones, Data, and Deterrence: Technology's Role in Public Safety

reader_summary.headline: I woke up Sunday morning to the most shocking email I've ever received from a company.
reader_summary.overview: I woke up Sunday morning to the most shocking email I've ever received from a company. Every piece of that technology is the equivalent of three police officers. It can get into places and see things and detect things that I don't care how good of a cop you are.

key_points.text: It can get into places and see things and detect things that I don't care how good of a cop you are.
key_points.evidence_quote: It can get into places and see things and detect things that I don't care how good of a cop you are, you would never be able to see it.

key_points.text: Show me a list of crimes that aren't being solved in a city, and we'll go build technology to change that.

thesis: The podcast argues that public safety technology, such as the cameras used by Flock Safety, can solve crimes and bring perpetrators to justice, exemplified by a specific incident in Atlanta where a kidnapped baby was rescued. The discussion emphasizes that despite the industry being misunderstood, leveraging technology to bolster public safety is a critical way to make communities safer without becoming 'big brother'.
